## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- **No inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID selectors only:** every design property, layout rule, and state is applied via classes/IDs defined in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML modifications:** markup stays semantic and style-agnostic — a full retheme must be achievable by editing `style.css` alone.

### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
Store every visual token in `:root` (and theme overrides). No hard-coded hex values outside token definitions. Required tokens and starter values:

- **Color:** `--primary: #800000` (wine red — CTAs, rules, hover underlines, featured frames) · `--secondary: #FFD700` (gold — decorative accents) · `--bg-primary: #FEFEFE` (**never `#FFFFFF` as a background** — the spec's pure white maps to `#FEFEFE`) · `--bg-secondary: #F5F5DC` (beige — alternating sections, card surfaces) · `--text-primary: #000000` · `--text-secondary: #333333` · `--text-success: #1E8C2E` (emerald darkened for light-bg contrast) · `--text-error: #C62828` · `--border-default: #E0E0E0` · `--border-error: #C62828` · `--border-success: #2ECC40` · `--accent-navy: #000080` (links, focus rings, numerals).
- **Shape & depth:** `--radius-sm: 0` · `--radius-md: 2px` · `--radius-lg: 4px` (sharp, printed-page feel) · `--shadow-sm: 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08)` · `--shadow-md: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.14)`.
- **Motion & space:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem` · `--transition-fast: .25s ease-in-out` · `--transition-normal: .5s ease-in-out` · `--ease-standard: ease-in-out`.
- **Elevation:** `--z-dropdown: 10` · `--z-modal: 100` · `--z-toast: 200`.
- **Type:** `--font-display: "Playfair Display", Georgia, serif` · `--font-base: "Inter", Arial, sans-serif`.
- **Contrast pairing (enforced in every theme):** light backgrounds pair with dark text; dark backgrounds pair with light text. Gold `#FFD700` must never appear as text on light backgrounds — restrict it to decorative rules, frames, badges, and text on dark/wine surfaces. On dark surfaces, never use navy or wine as text color; use gold, beige, or white.

### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support
- Define dark tokens under **both** `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `[data-theme="dark"]` selector. Starter values: `--bg-primary: #0D0D0D` · `--bg-secondary: #1B1B1B` · `--text-primary: #FEFEFE` · `--text-secondary: #C9C5B5` · `--text-success: #2ECC40` · `--text-error: #FF7A70` · `--border-default: #333333`; keep `--primary: #800000` (fills/borders paired with light text) and `--secondary: #FFD700`.
- **Theme switching:** background and text variables must swap seamlessly with zero HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** store the user's choice in `localStorage`, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, and render a visible toggle (sun/moon Material Symbols icon) with correct `aria-pressed` and `aria-label` states.
- **Exception clause:** the source style spec requested a light-only presentation — treat light mode as the default and primary experience, but a complete, fully styled dark mode must still be delivered per these mandatory architecture rules.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- Build every layout structure with Flexbox.
- **Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center`** unless an exception is explicitly justified.
- Mobile-first: multi-column rows collapse to columns on small viewports; **no horizontal scrolling at any breakpoint**; fluid type via `clamp()`.

### 1.5 CSS Architecture & Naming Convention
- Use **clean custom CSS** in `style.css` (the source spec supplies custom CSS, so Tailwind is not required; if used at all, only via `@layer`/`@apply` mapping to these same tokens).
- **One convention only — BEM** (e.g., `.pricing-card`, `.pricing-card__title`, `.pricing-card--featured`). Never mix conventions.
- Required generic reusable classes: `.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group` — plus the three mandatory spec classes `.magazine-cover`, `.article-layout-multilayer`, `.decorative-frame`.

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- **Text fonts:** load Playfair Display (400/700/900 + italic) and Inter (400/500/700) from Google Fonts via `<link>` with `preconnect`; bind to `--font-display` / `--font-base`. Body `line-height: 1.7`.
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the official stylesheet link. **Inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji-as-icons are forbidden.**
- Editorial type treatments: uppercase letter-spaced kickers, drop caps on excerpts, oversized Playfair numerals for steps and prices.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Button Component (`.btn` + variants)
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target **44×44px**. Variants: `.btn--primary` (wine fill, white text), `.btn--outline` (black border, transparent), `.btn--gold` (gold fill, black text), `.btn--danger`.
- **Hover:** brightness/shadow shift with `cursor: pointer`.
- **Focus:** distinct visible ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` using tokens (navy on light, gold on dark).
- **Active/pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or animated Material Symbol **without changing button dimensions** (apply to newsletter submit and pricing CTAs).
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** temporary feedback styling driven by `--text-success` / `--text-error`.

### 2.2 Card Component (`.card`)
- **Default:** flexible Flexbox layout; surfaces of `--bg-secondary` or `#FEFEFE` with `1px solid var(--border-default)` and subtle elevation.
- **Hover:** shadow shift plus `transform: translateY(-2px)`; on article cards, add image `scale(1.03)` inside an `overflow: hidden` frame and a wine-red underline reveal on the headline.
- **Focus-within:** card border highlights (wine/gold) when a child link or button receives focus.
- **Loading (skeleton):** CSS shimmer animation on image areas with reserved aspect ratios — no layout jumps while images load.
- **Empty state:** structured fallback with a Google Icon and guidance text for any dynamically loaded region.

### 2.3 Form & Input Requirements (`.input-group`)
- Used for the newsletter email capture (Final CTA and/or footer).
- **Structure:** flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input field, and a dedicated error/success feedback element.
- **States:** empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border + check icon), invalid (error border, error message, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- Announce validation feedback through an `aria-live="polite"` region.

### 2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements
- If any overlay is used (e.g., issue preview or subscription confirmation), cover all states: **opening, open, loading, success/error, closing** — animated via CSS transitions.
- Centered flex container (`align-items: center`), backdrop overlay, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trapping, and close via `Esc` or overlay click.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by default:** fluid sizing, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth animations:** apply `transition: var(--transition-normal)` to state changes. Implement the **magazine page-turn reveal**: sections/cards enter with a subtle `rotateY` under `perspective`, triggered by an `.is-visible` class added via `IntersectionObserver` in `script.js`. Under `prefers-reduced-motion`, replace all flips/zooms with simple fades.
- **Accessibility:** WCAG-compliant contrast in **both** modes; never communicate state by color alone (pair color with icons or text); semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`); a single `h1` and logical heading hierarchy; correct ARIA on the accordion (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) and theme toggle (`aria-pressed`); logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` regions for dynamic feedback; visible skip-to-content link.
- **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive actions:** any destructive link/action (e.g., "Cancel subscription" in FAQ or footer) uses `.btn--danger` / distinct error styling, clearly visible in both themes.
